tenderSchedule.title: NAME BOARD TENDER
tenderSchedule.deptName: Department Of Personnel and Administrative Reforms

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
All the Terms and conditions has to be followed as per Tender Documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience Certificate to having minimum one year experience in this field

Annual turnover records for the last 3 years to confirm financial stability. Audit reports for the last three years (Assessment Years 2023-2024 to 2025-2026)
